title: US strikes on Iranian nuclear sites as part of a hidden timeline war among entities

tellings.quote: meta question of if, you know, is our earthly conflict, you know, Trump just took out, you know, uh, three, uh, Iranian nuclear sites with with, you know, some B2s. Is all of that existing, you know, against some subrosa backdrop of like some timeline adjustment conflict or

plain: The idea here is that the 2025 American strikes on Iran, in which President Donald Trump sent B-2 stealth bombers to hit three Iranian nuclear sites, might be part of a hidden war between unseen entities fighting over which version of the future comes to pass. Michels raises it himself, as an open question rather than a claim, in a 2025 conversation with the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore, who studies the psychedelic drug DMT. He asks whether earthly conflicts like this one play out against a secret backdrop of a struggle to adjust the timeline, which would mean world events are moved by forces no one sees.
